blurb: Great Southwest Equestrian Center is a premier equestrian center and host to some of the most prestigious horse shows in the country, with 70,000 class entries each year. Breeds and disciplines showing at GSWEC include; American Saddlebreds, Arabians, Miniature Horses, Dressage, Hunters/Jumpers and Reining, in addition to numerous other events such as the Houston Livestock Show & Rodeo Horse Judging and Go Texas
